---
title: "Session 15 guided lab"
subtitle: "Bootstrap and permutation"
---

Work in **BIOS6301-mywork.Rproj**. Copy the starter from the separate course clone
into `work/session15/`: [Quarto](starter/resampling-lab.qmd) or [R Markdown](starter/resampling-lab.Rmd).
All inputs are synthetic.

## Tasks following the lecture

1. **Bootstrap within arms** — Estimate the Treatment-minus-Placebo mean difference in 12-week SBP. Bootstrap participants within each arm. Report bootstrap bias, SE, percentile and basic intervals, and compare the SE with Welch. Repeat interval endpoints with three documented seeds.
2. **Permutation tests** — Under the sharp null for the supplied completely randomized design, permute arm labels, retain 999 statistics, and compute the adjusted two-sided p-value. Report its resolution and a binomial interval for the Monte Carlo tail probability. Inspect the supplied demonstration of all 70 assignments for four participants per arm.
3. **Choose resampling units** — Use trial_long to compare row and participant bootstraps. Preserve all visits and repeated copies of sampled participants. Explain how paired, site-stratified, or clinic-randomized designs change the resampling or reassignment rule.

## In-class route and follow-up

Build one bootstrap and one permutation calculation in class, then inspect the participant-resampling demonstration. Complete the seed-stability comparison and design explanations afterward. Exact enumeration code is supplied for inspection.

## Exit evidence

Submit the source and rendered report with results, checks, interpretation, and
an AI-use disclosure. Identify the analysis sample or resampling unit for each result.
